nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a natural number, let $K = \mathbb{Q}(i\sqrt{D}) \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ and let $\mathcal{O}_K$ be its ring of integers. For integers $a, b, c$ with $a \ne 0$, the ideal class of the triple $(a, b, c)$ is the class, in the class group of $\mathcal{O}_K$, of the nonzero fractional ideal of $\mathcal{O}_K$ in $K$ generated by $a$ and $(b + i\sqrt{D})/2$.
nodes.title: Ideal class of a binary quadratic form

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a natural number and let $a, b, c$ be integers with $b^2 - 4ac = -D$. Then the element $(b + i\sqrt{D})/2$ of the field $\mathbb{Q}(i\sqrt{D}) \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ is integral over $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: The form generator is an algebraic integer

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a natural number and let $a, b, c$ be integers with $a \ne 0$. Then the fractional ideal of the ring of integers of $\mathbb{Q}(i\sqrt{D}) \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ generated by $a$ and $(b + i\sqrt{D})/2$ is nonzero.
nodes.title: The ideal of a form is nonzero

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a natural number, let $K = \mathbb{Q}(i\sqrt{D}) \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ and let $\mathcal{O}_K$ be its ring of integers. For integers $a, b, c$, the ideal of the triple $(a, b, c)$ is the fractional ideal of $\mathcal{O}_K$ in $K$ generated by $a$ and $(b + i\sqrt{D})/2$.
nodes.title: Ideal of a binary quadratic form

nodes.summary: For every positive integer $D$, the subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i\sqrt{D})$ of $\mathbb{C}$ has degree $2$ over $\mathbb{Q}$.
nodes.title: $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$ is a quadratic extension

nodes.summary: For a natural number $D$, this is the subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i\sqrt{D})$ of $\mathbb{C}$ generated over $\mathbb{Q}$ by the imaginary root $i\sqrt{D}$.
nodes.title: The imaginary quadratic field $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $D$, the complex number $i\sqrt{D}$ is integral over $\mathbb{Q}$.
nodes.title: The imaginary root is integral over $\mathbb{Q}$

nodes.summary: For every positive integer $D$, the complex number $i\sqrt{D}$ does not lie in the subfield $\mathbb{Q}$ of $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: The imaginary root is not rational

nodes.summary: For every natural number $D$, the complex number $i\sqrt{D}$ satisfies $(i\sqrt{D})^2 = -D$.
nodes.title: The imaginary root squares to $-D$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $D$, the imaginary root of $D$ is the complex number $i\sqrt{D}$, where $\sqrt{D}$ is the nonnegative real square root; it is the square root of $-D$ with nonnegative imaginary part.
nodes.title: The imaginary square root of $-D$

nodes.summary: The integral binary quadratic form $a x^2 + b x y + c y^2$ is Gauss reduced when $a > 0$, its discriminant $b^2 - 4ac$ is negative, $|b| \le a \le c$, and $b \ge 0$ whenever $|b| = a$ or $a = c$.
nodes.title: Gauss-reduced binary quadratic forms

nodes.summary: For integers $a, b, c$ and real numbers $x, y$, the real quadratic form of the triple $(a, b, c)$ takes the value $a x^2 + b x y + c y^2$ at the point $(x, y)$.
nodes.title: Evaluation of the real quadratic form of a coefficient triple

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be a positive integer and let $a, b, c$ be integers with $a > 0$ and $b^2 - 4ac = -D$. Then the real quadratic form $(x, y) \mapsto a x^2 + b x y + c y^2$ on $\mathbb{R}^2$ is positive definite.
nodes.title: Positive definiteness for negative discriminant

nodes.summary: For integers $a, b, c$, this is the quadratic form on the real vector space $\mathbb{R}^2$ given by $(x, y) \mapsto a x^2 + b x y + c y^2$.
nodes.title: Real quadratic form of an integer coefficient triple

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
